items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire (a direction key fires, does not move); E places a bomb and decrements bomb HUD; wall hint ITEM=Space untested. HUD shows hearts, coins, bombs, keys, curse icon. Death indicators seen: empty heart outlines with pale ghost sprite once; a bloodied X-eyed body with a clean sprite above — likely death, unconfirmed."+"

ITEM 'TECH X' (observed): obtained twice (red chest in a treasure room; green/white pill floating above a rock in the two-poop room). Firing spawns a laser ring ahead in the fire direction; it lingers/drifts, grinds overlapping targets, then fades. Ring spawn distance is NOT fixed (~200–325px measured, variable), so distance-math aiming is unreliable; point-blank shots overshoot. Sustained fire was needed to kill a blue fly. Laser is weak vs brown poop; bombs broke poop piles; purple/golden-brown poop vanished on contact for a coin. Poop piles regenerate on room re-entry."+"

CHESTS (observed): gray/metal chests open by firing into them, or by contact once the room's enemies are dead. Drops seen: heart + bomb orb (one case), and a heart pickup alone; a red heart pickup standing at full hearts converted into a bomb (+1 bomb). A red treasure-room chest gave an item on contact. In the dark chest room, two corner red-lidded chests did NOT open despite many laser hits that visibly registered (impact sparks); unresolved — possibly need contact, a key, or they are mimics. Touching a corner chest earlier cost several hearts in one contact (mimic/spike chest guess, unconfirmed). Top-left red chest in the dark room appeared tilted/opened with black spiders beside it (whether it spawned them unconfirmed). Central red chest ringed by white spikes stayed closed to laser hits. Key-shaped floor sprites turned out to be my own laser particles, not pickups; HUD keys have stayed 0."+"

BOMBS (observed): E places at feet; blast damages the player — even a 0.5s retreat from adjacent placement cost a heart, so retreat far; a bomb placed inside a rock pocket cleared rocks but the player still took a heart. Bombs destroyed rock rings earlier; a bomb against suspicious cracked/stained right-wall patterns did nothing (likely decorative). A bomb beside the white spike ring removed no spikes."+"

HAZARDS (observed): black spider-like enemies in the dark chest room are melee chasers and lethal (killed player at 2 hearts). White round-faced enemies (probably hoppers) in the rock-field room are dangerous; health fell full to empty quickly there. White spike ring around the central red chest is likely damaging; it is plus/cross-shaped with gaps at the four diagonals — traversability untested. Corner torches in the torch room damage on contact (a wall-hugging descent into the bottom-left corner cost a heart). Diagonal rock chains block straight AND diagonal movement; single-axis moves through gaps worked better (upper lane past a rock was reachable only after rising first)."+"

TRANSITIONS (observed): bottom gold trapdoors descend only when standing fully centered; top gold crown hatches warp from centered below with sustained W (nudging to center needed). Dark trapezoid doorways at top/bottom centers are ordinary connections needing sustained walking. Right-wall doorways need the correct vertical band (tutorial room roughly y 310–400). UNRESOLVED: in the dark chest room, sustained left pushes beside the left-wall door marking (y~345–360, marking spans ~y330–395) failed to transition back to the tutorial room — marking may be decorative, band narrower/different, or entry needs a pure single-axis approach. Entry into the dark room was via the tutorial's right doorway."+"

MAP RELATIONSHIPS (observed/guessed): Tutorial room (wall hints, top and bottom trapezoid doors, right-wall doorway) — bottom door → torch room with a central gray chest inside/atop a rock cluster, corner torches, brown poop, scorch mark, top trapezoid door, bottom gold trapdoor. Its top door loops back to the tutorial room. Earlier run: bottom route led to a red treasure-chest room (gave Tech X), then a gray-chest room with torches/rocks/poop/blue fly, then the two-poop room (central rock, two poop piles, top crown hatch returning to torch room). Tutorial right doorway → dark chest room (corner red chests, spike-ringed central chest, black poop, black spiders). Tutorial top door → rock-field room: many gray rocks, a golden chest-like object embedded in the left wall (possibly needs a key, or is a door), white round-faced hopper enemies; other exits unconfirmed. The torch room's bottom gold trapdoor was never successfully reached."+"

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact-opening a metal chest before enemies died; firing while too close (ring overshoots); entering hatches/trapdoors from offset; treating floor key-sprites as pickups; bombing the spike ring; laser on the corner red chests; long pushes into the dark room's left wall; lingering near white hoppers at low health; assuming an open-looking lane is clear (repeatedly got wedged in a rock pocket around the torch room chest — right-side pocket consistently blocked; escaping upward then sideways worked)."+"

ACTIVE GOALS: find health pickups (most cleared rooms gave none; hearts are the scarcest resource); reach the torch room's bottom gold trapdoor; identify/open the golden wall object in the rock-field room; determine how to open the red-lidded corner chests or whether they are mimics; test the diagonal gaps of the white spike ring to reach the central red chest; test Space (ITEM).
